concept.title: Editing your Data Migration App Using the Wizard

conbody.p: When you want to modify a Data Migration App to add, remove or change Objects, Fields, Lookups, or change Filters and other settings, go to the Data Migration Wizard and select Edit.

note.p: If the changes you want to make to the Data Migration App are significant enough, it is recommended to create a new app rather than modify an existing one.
